title: Commission approves €5 billion German State aid scheme to support decarbonisation of industry
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 07 May 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €5 billion German scheme to help companies in industrial sectors decarbonise their production processes. The scheme contributes to achieving Germany's energy and climate targets, as well as the EU's sustainable prosperity and competitiveness objectives.
